summary.headline: Planetary Significations in Eighth and Ninth Houses
summary.text: Astrological significations of the planets in the eighth and ninth houses: marriage, women, inheritances from relatives, death, wounds, poverty, royal adversity, mourning, dreams, religious error, disease, impediments, and losses on distant journeys.
